firstPlayerRule: Randomly assign the Visiting and Home teams. The Visiting team plays first.
clarifications: This revised rulebook states that it covers the base game, Spring Training and Bases Loaded.
In each mini-game, the Visiting team plays the first card and the teams then alternate turns.
